verdict.rationale: Bulk data import is a fair question for an identity and fraud platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no bulk import capability for customers or transactions, no import job tracking, and no way to resume after a partial failure. The cited material covers only adjacent features: per-event real-time submission through the Events API, webhook delivery retries, and 206 statuses for partial vendor data on a single Evaluation. None of these is a bulk import that can be tracked or resumed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track bulk customer and transaction imports and resume after partial failure
